heading: Tuesday, June 3, 2025
topLine: Drug for an AI-identified fibrosis target shows safety and a lung-function signal in phase 2a.

items.headline: Drug for an AI-identified fibrosis target shows safety and a lung-function signal in phase 2a
items.summary: Insilico Medicine's rentosertib, whose target TNIK and whose molecule both came from the company's generative AI platform, met its safety endpoint in a double-blind, placebo-controlled 71-patient, 12-week trial in idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis in China, with forced vital capacity changing by +98.4 mL at 60 mg once daily versus -20.3 mL on placebo. Published in Nature Medicine; efficacy was a secondary endpoint in a small single-country trial and needs larger studies.
